basis.saw: the 17-tile UN Sustainable Development Goals poster with the SDG emblem

narrative.text: The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) poster grid: three rows of six tiles showing the 17 numbered, colour-coded SDG icons and titles from 1 (No Poverty) to 17 (Partnerships for the Goals), with the Sustainable Development Goals emblem and UN colour wheel in the eighteenth tile at the lower right. Placed in section 3 ('Rationale: Policy frameworks, mandate and context of NHWA') above the discussion of the 2030 Agenda and SDG target 3.c.

basis.saw: the cover of the WHO publication 'Global strategy on human resources for health: Workforce 2030'

narrative.text: The cover of the World Health Organization publication 'Global strategy on human resources for health: Workforce 2030': a dark teal cover featuring the WHO emblem and wordmark at the upper left, the title in white and orange text, and a swirling circular motif of teal and orange dots below. Placed beside the paragraph describing the endorsement of the Global Strategy by the Sixty-ninth World Health Assembly in resolution WHA69.19.

basis.saw: the cover of the report 'Working for health and growth: investing in the health workforce'

narrative.text: The cover of the report of the High-Level Commission on Health Employment and Economic Growth, 'Working for health and growth: investing in the health workforce': a light blue and white geometric cover showing the Commission header at top, the title 'WORKING FOR HEALTH AND GROWTH' with a stylized tree icon, the subtitle 'Investing in the health workforce', and triangular inset photographs of health workers and community members.
